about: Where `$$` display maths opens and closes, read the same on the phone (apps/mobile/lib/markdown/displayDollars.ts) and on the server (apps/api/app/modules/chat/display_dollars.py). remark-math's rule: a delimiter is a run of exactly two unescaped dollars (three or more, or one in brackets, is a price tier); it opens a formula at the start of a line (after its indent, a quote mark or a list marker), which may run on over the lines below, or mid-line as $$x$$ with nothing between the dollars and the formula, closed on its line; a formula never reaches across a list item or a table row, and a pair on a table row never spans a |. Inline code holds no maths. `display` lists each formula's text between its dollars, trimmed, in order. The phone's tests (lib/__tests__/displayDollars.test.ts) read every case with the reader, convertBlockMath and the streaming scanners; the server's (app/tests/modules/chat/test_display_dollars.py) with its reader, display_math_lines and the LaTeX check.
